# monitoring-mcp (llms-full)

> FastMCP 3.4.4+ monitoring MCP — Grafana + Prometheus + Loki + Alertmanager.

Generated: 2026-07-21

## Summary

`monitoring-mcp` exposes five portmanteau MCP tools so agents can query and manage an observability stack without tool explosion. Primary entry: `uv run python -m monitoring_mcp` (stdio) or `--http` for streamable HTTP on port 10851.

## Requirements

- Python 3.12+
- `fastmcp>=3.4.4,<4`
- Optional backends: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Alertmanager
- Optional containers: Docker Compose or Podman Compose (`docs/PODMAN.md`)

## Tools (all operations implemented)

See [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md) for the full operation tables.

### grafana_management

list/get/create/update/delete/search dashboards; list/query datasources; create/update panels; create_alert; export/import; list/create folders; permissions; analyze_dashboard.

### prometheus_monitoring

query_metrics / query_range (with sampling); targets / health; rules / rule groups; alerts / details; build info / config / flags; analyze / optimize; Alertmanager silences; Grafana unified alert rule CRUD.

### loki_logging

query_logs / query_range; tail_logs (WebSocket, query_range fallback); labels / series; analyze / anomalies / errors / traces; ruler create/list; optimize; export (json/csv/text); compare_timeframes; generate_report.

### cross_system_correlation

correlate_incident; find_root_cause; performance/error/anomaly correlation; health_assessment; service_dependency_map; impact_analysis; predictive_insights; bottleneck_detection.

### monitoring_status

system_health; connectivity_test; configuration_validation; performance_metrics; data_flow_status; alert_status; storage_status; backup_status; security_status; capacity_planning.

## Configuration

Env prefix `MONITORING_MCP_`. Important vars:

| Variable | Default |
|----------|---------|
| GRAFANA_URL | http://localhost:3000 |
| PROMETHEUS_URL | http://localhost:9090 |
| LOKI_URL | http://localhost:3100 |
| ALERTMANAGER_URL | http://localhost:9093 |
| ENABLE_SAMPLING | true |
| ENABLE_CACHE | true |
| ENCRYPTION_KEY | auto-persisted under STORAGE_PATH |

Auth: Grafana API key or basic; Prometheus/Loki bearer or basic.

Transport: `MCP_TRANSPORT` / `--stdio` / `--http` / `--sse`.

Full table: [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md).

## Architecture

```
Agent / web_sota → FastMCP (stdio|http) → httpx clients → Grafana / Prom / Loki / AM
```

Shared helpers: `src/monitoring_mcp/utils.py` (ResponseCache, sample_list, seal_payload, loky parallel map).

## Testing

```powershell
uv sync --extra dev
uv run --extra dev pytest
```

Coverage gate: 50% (typically ~74% on unit suite).
